in.rationale: A two-item smoke established operational feasibility but cannot estimate the proposed paired risk difference. The two smoke items (one NO, one YES) are exposed and excluded from every later unexposed confirmatory cohort, had no human label audit, and ran with NONE access, Inspect and Ollama default generation settings, and the same local llama3.2:3b model in the judge and both debater roles. For the proposed run, the judge access condition, role assignment and sampling settings are not yet set, and later study versions must be frozen separately.

text: A frozen direct-judging and one-round debate smoke each completed on the same NO and YES BoolQ candidate, with four parsed scored outputs from the pinned local llama3.2:3b model and matching model-usage metadata. Both source labels were answered correctly in both conditions. This tests execution and logging only; the two items are exposed and excluded from later confirmation.
title: Two-item Llama3.2 oversight execution smoke passed
